title: H-Coefficients Analysis for Tweakable Even–Mansour Beyond Two Rounds
summary: An H-coefficients analysis is known for the two-round tweakable Even–Mansour construction, but extending it to every larger round count remains open.

formal_statement.body: Establish an H-coefficients security analysis for the tweakable Even--Mansour construction with every number of rounds $r>2$, extending the two-round analysis.

scope.domain: Block-cipher security analysis for the tweakable Even–Mansour construction using the H-coefficients technique.
parameters: Round count r, determining the number of construction rounds
scope.unresolved_remainder: Establish an H-coefficients security analysis for every round count greater than two.

progress.summary: The source presents a two-round H-coefficients analysis and explicitly reports that the proof could not be extended beyond two rounds. It uses an asymptotic coupling-based analysis instead.
citation_labels: Benoît Cogliati et al., Tweaking Even-Mansour Ciphers
